title: Chapter 701
text:
Planet Gautin was the first test area of Godora's' Discrimination Modification 'plan. Regardless of whether they were purebloods or hybrids, all the Godora people had their eyes on Gautin, wanting to know what Serbia the Fifth was doing.

Under the watchful eyes of the public, a giant flagship of the Amethyst Civilization arrived at Planet Gautin and used some kind of device to release an invisible psychic current to the entire planet. Serbia the Fifth announced that Purple Crystal had used a secret Star Cluster level technology to modify the thoughts of the Godora people on a large scale. He also assured the public that this device was very reliable. In reality, this was just a disguise that he had discussed with Purple Crystal to make it seem like a huge commotion and reduce the public's uneasiness.

The key person who actually carried out the Discrimination Modification was naturally Rossellin. This was the first time she displayed her ability in front of Han Xiao. The large-scale psychic current that the Purple Crystal flagship released on Planet Gautin was actually a device that strengthened the psychic power of Rossellin's Esper Ability, greatly increasing the range of her Esper Ability.

Psychics also had hypnosis and brainwashing techniques, but the accuracy and range were not as good as Rossellin's [Thought Infection] Esper Ability. Her Esper Ability was a shallow brainwashing, and the process was very gentle. It was done subtly and did not affect the person's personality. Instead, it gave the target a new way of looking at things. It could even be said that Rossellin had opened up a new perspective of the world for the target. This Esper Ability was very suitable for preaching and shaping ideas.

The modification project lasted for two days. The fat nerds in Gautin were originally very uneasy, but as time passed, they did not notice any changes in their thoughts. They gradually became suspicious and thought that it was not effective.

Two days later, the Purple Crystal flagship left. All the Godora people were paying attention to the results of the experiment. The internet was filled with topics about Planet Gautin. Everyone participated and asked curiously.

"Are there any residents of Gautin? Come out and tell us how you feel."

"I don't feel any changes. Am I the only one?"

"No, I'm also from Gautin. I don't feel any changes."

"Did it fail?"

"Uh, I don't know if you guys feel the same way. At first, I thought that it wouldn't work, but just now, I took the initiative to chat with a mixed-blood friend. At first, I was a little repulsed by him, but when I saw him just now, I was actually calm and even felt that he had delicate features … Cough, cough, I'm anonymous. I don't want him to find out."

"Is that so? I'm not quite the same as you. I have a mixed-blood friend too. I thought he was quite ugly at first, but after video chatting with him just now, although I still think he's ugly, the disgust that I felt from time to time is gone."

The people of Godora gradually understood the changes in the residents of Gauting. The transformed individuals maintained their own personalities, and even knew what kind of changes they had undergone.

This result made Godora feel more at ease. At least they did not forcefully distort their thoughts.

Serbia the Fifth had been paying attention to the reactions of the people. Seeing this, he held another press conference to emphasize that the Discrimination Modification Plan was harmless. He also wanted to let the people know about their changes and respect the individual's right to know.

At the same time, the government was secretly guiding public opinion, trying to make the people feel that accepting mixed-bloods was a policy that would never change in Godora. Since they could not change the general trend, perhaps changing themselves was a good choice and could make the atmosphere of society better.

The success of the experiment and the control of public opinion did indeed make some people less wary. Some people even approved of this idea — by accepting the modification, the mixed-bloods that were not pleasing to the eye would no longer make them feel disgusted, and their daily lives would become more harmonious.

With the first success, Serbia the Fifth had more confidence. After observing for a long time and using various methods to confirm that the residents of Gauting did not suffer any sequelae, he was finally at ease. He vigorously promoted the plan and allowed all the colonial planets of Godora to accept the modification.

The people of Godora called this the Discrimination Modification Campaign.

The pure-blooded diehards had power and influence. Even if the Discrimination Modification did not cause any sequelae, they were not willing to accept it. Thus, they used their power and influence to create external resistance for Serbia the Fifth.

The network of connections of the upper class even caused the government to have problems. The diehards stirred up public opinion to smear Serbia the Fifth, saying that he was a lunatic, even crazier than Dark-star. They said that he was leading Godora to its grave and become a slave to the advanced civilizations.

Many people were influenced by public opinion and became very angry. They said that the government did not ask for their opinion and wanted to change their minds. What did they think they were? Serbia the Fifth's reputation on the Internet plummeted, and he was even called the "Second Generation Leader of Dark-star".

However, Serbia the Fifth was not angry. Instead, he was happy and used this opportunity to publicly explain. Regardless of whether the people believed it or not, this was an opportunity. As long as he did what he wanted, he could create his own image.

Some conspiracy theorists naturally did not listen to the explanation and were even more excited. Serbia the Fifth did not stand on ceremony with them and asked people to invite them to tea so that they would stop.

He did not care about these smears. To him, this was just a painful process. When the plan was completed, the entire galactic society would naturally have a high opinion of him, and he would become the most powerful leader in the history of Godora.

When the upper class saw that public opinion was useless, they secretly funded high-ranking officials in the government, hoping to impeach Serbia the Fifth and find a way to change the leader.

Unfortunately, ever since they entered the galactic era, Godora had already taken back a lot of the privileges of the nobles. Furthermore, Godora was a hereditary system, and the system was not democratic. Serbia the Fifth also had the support of Purple Crystal, so his position was impregnable. Therefore, facing the counterattack of the upper class, Serbia the Fifth scoffed.

Serbia the Fifth was not willing to waste time scheming against each other. Therefore, he directly talked to many of the diehards of the upper class with a very firm attitude. If you continue to cause trouble, you will have to pay back all the benefits the government has given you in the past. You can go wherever you want to go.

The upper class was terrified. Seeing that all kinds of methods could not stop the Discrimination Transformation Movement, they realized that there was nothing they could do. Therefore, they changed the content of their protest and believed that if the purebloods had to be transformed, the hybrids had to be transformed too. Otherwise, there would be hidden dangers.

The hybrids had always been bullied, and they had accumulated resentment. After some research, some of the rebellious hybrids were indifferent to the Discrimination Transformation Movement. They felt that the purebloods had discriminated against them for so many years and caused so many tragedies. Now that they no longer discriminated against them, how could there be such a good thing in the world?

Serbia the Fifth did not ignore them. The hybrids had to be transformed and treated equally.

Godora's Discrimination Transformation Movement was in full swing and caused an uproar in the galaxy. A small Star System civilization successfully dominated the headlines for a period of time. Even the Star Cluster civilizations in the Shattered Star Ring were watching curiously.

The government brainwashing all its citizens — this was too rare.

Countless galactic reporters swarmed over, and Serbia the Fifth decided to hold a press conference to answer the questions that these reporters were most interested in.

A day later, these famous media outlets released their own reports. One of the reports became popular in the galaxy and received the most approval.

In the report, Serbia the Fifth received a positive evaluation and was praised to the sky. The reporter believed that the discrimination modification movement was a powerful medicine that was precisely targeted at the stubborn problem of bloodline conflict. Only a leader as bold as Serbia the Fifth would dare to carry out such a seemingly crazy plan. Although there were many obstacles at the moment, it was actually beneficial for the future of the civilization.

In the report, Serbia the Fifth was described as a leader of great talent, vision, and courage.

The report also interviewed many Godora hybrids who were wandering outside, and many of them revealed their intention to return to Godora. The reporters called this phenomenon 'Godora's Grand Unification Trend'. The idea that Dark-star could not complete was achieved by Serbia the Fifth instead, and it was even better. The reporters felt that this was very dramatic.

The Purple Crystal Civilization was also evaluated as being warm-hearted and responsible, and they were willing to step forward to resolve the internal conflicts of the civilizations under their jurisdiction. Their credibility was increased, and this was a pleasant surprise, indirectly increasing the support of the Purple Crystal Civilization in the three border Star Systems.

The report also mentioned Han Xiao and felt that his capture of the Dark-star leader was the source of everything that happened later. This allowed Godora and Purple Crystal to get closer, which indirectly led to the Discrimination Transformation Movement.

Although outsiders did not know that the Discrimination Transformation Movement was actually the result of Han Xiao pulling the strings behind the scenes, this report did not forget about him. It felt that Black Star's contribution was also indispensable and gave him a share of the credit, making his reputation in the galaxy even more positive.

Han Xiao also saw this report and felt very good … Sure enough, the eyes of the masses were sharp!

In his previous life, no player had completed the [Bloodline] mission, and Godora's bloodline conflicts continued to fester. Although there were no more terrorist organizations like Dark-star, the sharper internal conflicts caused the hybrids to have fewer and fewer opportunities to rise up the ranks. They were all at the bottom of society, and this led to a large exodus of hybrids. At the same time, it gave birth to many rebel forces and endless internal conflicts.

If not for the mission, Han Xiao would not have cared about the internal conflicts of Godora. His original intention was to complete the mission and get the reward, but the result seemed to be a good thing.

The current Godora government had done what Dark-star could not. Han Xiao could not help but want to see how Dark-star's leader would react to this.

…

The Rainbow Light Prison was an independent interstellar fortress that floated in the universe and was heavily guarded.

Han Xiao could now move freely in Godora. Not to mention a prison, he could even enter Serbia the Fifth's room. He requested to visit the Rainbow Prison, and Godora agreed without hesitation.

The Blacklight Stealth arrived at the Rainbow Prison and stopped at the dock. The warden came out to welcome him.

"It's my honor to meet you, Respected Hero of the Godora Medal, Friend of Godora, Your Excellency Black Star."

The warden was very respectful.

"I would like to visit the Dark-star members in the Rainbow Prison and then talk to the leader of Dark-star. Sorry to trouble you, warden."

Han Xiao smiled.

"Please follow me."

The warden led the way, and Han Xiao followed him into the Rainbow Prison.

They walked past many cells, all of which were Dark-star members. Han Xiao even saw the former Dark-star officer, Degulish. This guy's entire body was shackled with electromagnetic shackles, and his expression was numb. One look and one could tell that he was living a happy life in this prison.

After looking around, Han Xiao came to the most heavily guarded cell. The Dark-star leader was locked inside.

The warden personally opened the cell door and invited Han Xiao in. He then stayed outside to give the two of them some space to talk.

Han Xiao walked into the cell, and the cell door closed behind him. Darkness fell before his eyes. He casually summoned a hovering guard and turned it into a light source, illuminating the room.

The Dark-star leader was sitting in the corner, and his depressed aura had disappeared. He stared at Han Xiao with a complicated expression.

"It's you?"

"It's me. I'm here. I'm still here … I've answered the three questions you're going to ask. Can we talk about something else now?" Han Xiao rolled his eyes.

The Dark-star leader was speechless. Why do you like to stop people from talking?

At this time, the Dark-star leader suddenly realized that he and Black Star had been enemies for so long, and this was the first time the two of them had a proper chat.
